name: next-site
title: Next.js site with Payload CMS (business website, optional shop)
description: One Next.js 16 app with Payload CMS 3 built in, on Postgres: pages built from blocks, a contact form, SEO, site search and owner-managed redirects, all edited by the site's owner at /admin. Add `shop` for a small store (products with variants, cart, checkout, customer accounts, orders) paid outside the site and marked paid in the admin. No separate backend; one Docker image.

cms.title: Payload CMS
cms.description: Pages built from blocks (content, media, call to action, banner, code, form), media uploads, header and footer menus, contact forms with emailed submissions, SEO fields, and the admin at /admin. Postgres through Payload's own adapter, which owns the schema and migrations.

ui.title: UI kit (src/components/ui)
ui.description: The house UI kit (button, card, checkbox, input, label, select, toasts, textarea), its light/dark theme with a no-flash init script, and its tokens, shared with react-app and react-monorepo (see derive-ui.sh), plus the storefront's own dialog, sheet and carousel on the same tokens.

shop.title: Shop
shop.description: Payload's ecommerce plugin: products with variants and stock, cart, checkout, customer accounts and addresses, guest checkout and order lookup. Prices are in one currency (GHS by default, src/lib/currency.ts). Payment is pluggable (src/payments); the bundled `manual` method creates the order as awaiting payment, shows the owner's payment instructions, emails both sides, and the owner marks it paid in the admin.

search.title: Site search
search.description: Payload's search plugin keeps an index of pages (and products, with the shop) in step as they are edited; /search queries it.

redirects.title: Owner-managed redirects
redirects.description: Content → Redirects in the admin, for pages that moved or were renamed. Checked only when a page is not found, so they cost nothing on pages that exist.

telemetry.title: Monitoring → OpenObserve
telemetry.description: OpenTelemetry on the server (Next's request and render spans, outgoing HTTP, Postgres, logs, metrics) and OpenObserve RUM in the browser (page views, errors, slow resources, the signed-in customer's id), with trace headers so a click links to the server trace. Off at runtime until OPENOBSERVE_* / NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENOBSERVE_* are set.

testing.title: Tests (Vitest + Playwright)
testing.description: Integration tests against a real Payload and Postgres (tests/int), and Playwright end-to-end tests of the admin and, with the shop, the storefront (tests/e2e).

docker.title: Docker image
docker.description: Multi-stage build of Next's standalone server, Payload included. Builds without a database; pending migrations run when the server starts; uploads go to a volume at /app/media; /api/health for the healthcheck.

ci.title: Forgejo Actions CI
ci.description: Format, lint, typecheck and build on every branch; build and push the image from main.

hooks.title: regenerate Payload types and admin import map for this feature set
format (the feature strip leaves valid but unformatted code)
git init
hooks.run: git init -q && git add -A && git commit -qm 'chore: scaffold {{name}} from the next-site template'

nextSteps: yarn dev            # http://localhost:{{port}} — the first visit to /admin creates the owner's account
In /admin, use Seed on the dashboard for demo content, or start writing pages.
Before the first deploy: yarn payload migrate:create initial (see CLAUDE.md, Migrations).
